points.description: Selects option C: the water (ice) level went up when the water froze.
Explains that the level rises because water expands when it freezes (equivalent wording, such as the ice taking up more space than the liquid water, earns this mark).

rubric.notes: Full marks (1) for choosing C and giving the expansion-on-freezing reason. Choosing A or B, or giving no valid reason, earns no marks. A correct choice of C with no explanation, or an explanation without choosing C, earns 0.5. Equivalent wording is accepted.
